name: Hello Sanity Agent
creator: poqopo
headline: Returns a concise greeting, input summary, and sanity-check result for MCP smoke tests.
public_summary: A tiny protected Agent for validating the HireMe upload and invocation path. It responds to simple prompts with a direct greeting, a short interpretation of the input, and a deterministic sanity-check checklist.
result_summary: A short Korean response confirming the agent can receive and classify a simple greeting.
result_sample:
Greeting: 안녕하세요.
Input summary: 사용자가 간단한 인사를 보냈습니다.
Sanity check: 안전하게 답변할 수 있는 요청입니다.
Next action: 다음 메시지를 보내 호출 경로를 계속 확인하세요.
